what: The agreement theorems state an exact fuel (4*len+4, extra+1+1, loopFuel 2 2) and every proof wrote down each intermediate state; the first real encoder output added storage markers, temporaries and goto/return blocks, so every block lemma broke and three gate theorems became false (fuel one step short) and had to be restated.
cost: four hand-written proofs rewritten; three theorems.json statements changed
cause: the step count of a body is part of the theorem statement, and the proofs were written against a predicted body Lean never checked
workaround: mir_walk (lean/Blaze/Mir/Walk.lean) runs blocks by simp so no intermediate state is written; a statement of the form: some fuel suffices and every larger fuel gives the model result, would not change with the body
